title: Macro regime filter for XAUUSD (DXY/real yields) — position permission/sizing input
problem_statement: OHLCV-only technical features (Hyp-A, Hyp-B) show no exploitable edge on XAUUSD at H1/5-min. Test whether macro regime state (dollar strength, real yield momentum) carries information for a risk-on/risk-off filter, to be used for trade permission/sizing rather than standalone directional alpha.
target_definition: Ternary macro regime from DXY 20-session momentum: risk-on (DXY down > 0.5% over 20 sessions), neutral (|change| <= 0.5%), risk-off (DXY up > 0.5% over 20 sessions). Labeled at session close using DXY close prices; no XAUUSD price data used in label construction — pure macro regime classifier.
notes: REJECTED — XGBoost accuracy (57.6%) not meaningfully above class-prior baseline on the 3-class regime target; transition-baseline comparison invalidated due to target-space mismatch (binary transition-detection vs. 3-class regime label are not comparable), no valid evidence of predictive skill found. Standard persistence baseline was 82.6% accuracy (artificially inflated by label autocorrelation: 19/20 session overlap in 20-session momentum window). Features: DXY momentum_5, real yield level/momentum_5/20, VIX level/momentum_5/20. DXY momentum_20 removed from features to prevent leakage (directly constructs the target). Hyp-C rejected; macro regime filter does not add value for XAUUSD sizing filter.
